name: taiga-mcp
description: Read a Taiga 6 installation and, when allowed, create, edit, move and delete its items.
long_description: Connects Claude to a Taiga 6 installation. It reads projects, sprints, user stories, tasks, issues and their attachments in the name of the person whose token it has. With writing allowed it also creates, edits and moves user stories, tasks and issues and attaches files to them. With deleting allowed too, it deletes them after showing what would go and asking.

taiga_url.title: Taiga address
taiga_url.description: Address of your Taiga site. It must start with https://

taiga_token.title: Taiga token
taiga_token.description: The value of "token" in the Local Storage of the browser, after you log in to Taiga

allow_writing.title: Allow writing
allow_writing.description: Lets Claude create, edit and move user stories, tasks and issues and attach files, in your name

allow_deleting.title: Allow deleting
allow_deleting.description: Lets Claude delete user stories, tasks and issues. Taiga keeps no trash. It needs Allow writing
